template_note: The public standard chart used directly: every numbered account of the standard is created with account_no = standard_account_code. Headings and sums are not accounts (the standard: only numbered accounts can be posted to) and are in app/reporting/dk-standard-chart-structure.json. The standard allows horizontal dimensioning (a suffix after the number) and forbids vertical additions (new numbers are reserved for authorities), so the system accounts below are suffixed accounts. account_type, account_group, open_item_mode, tax_code_rule and revalue_flag are package choices derived from the number ranges and carry no legal claim. account_group is the code of the nearest heading (H plus its number)
